name: EMI / Loan Calculator
summary: Calculate monthly EMI, total interest, and an amortization schedule for a loan — locally.
description: Enter loan amount, annual interest rate, and tenure in years. See monthly EMI, total payment, total interest, and optionally the full month-by-month amortization schedule. Uses the standard reducing-balance EMI formula.

faqs.question: Which EMI formula is used?
faqs.answer: The standard reducing-balance formula: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1), where r is the monthly rate and n is the number of months.

faqs.question: Can the interest rate be zero?
faqs.answer: Yes. With 0% interest, the payment is simply principal divided by the number of months.

faqs.question: Is my loan data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
